en.小红书仅支持手动投稿，请使用发布页的“小红书手动投稿”资料。: Xiaohongshu posting is manual. Use the Xiaohongshu handoff in Publishing.
en.按所选平台使用以下入口。: Choose the action for your platform.
en.从本地资料复制文案和素材路径，在官方网页或 App 中手动上传。: Copy text and file paths, then upload manually on the official website or app.
en.小红书笔记是否包含 AI 生成或合成内容？: Does your Xiaohongshu note contain AI-generated or synthetic content?
en.不含 AI 生成或合成内容: Contains no AI-generated or synthetic content
en.请核对视频、音频、封面和文案。此选择仅写入本地资料，平台声明需手动设置。: Check the video, audio, cover and text. This selection is local; set the platform disclosure yourself.
en.请先确认小红书笔记是否包含 AI 生成或合成内容。: Confirm whether the Xiaohongshu note contains AI-generated or synthetic content.
en.含 AI 内容：请在小红书发布页使用“笔记内容声明”，选择“笔记含 AI 合成内: Contains AI content: use the note content disclosure on Xiaohongshu to mark the note as containing AI-generated content.
en.本地选择：不含 AI 生成或合成内容。若素材有变，请重新核对声明。: Local selection: no AI-generated or synthetic content. Check the disclosure again if the materials change.
en.本次未启用小红书草稿。: The Xiaohongshu draft is not enabled.
en.本次未启用 B站草稿。: The Bilibili draft is not enabled.
en.请生成与当前文稿一致的资料，再核对视频、封面和声明。: Generate files matching the current draft, then check the video, cover and disclosure.
en.小红书资料已核对。请复制文案并在官方端手动上传。: Xiaohongshu files checked. Copy the draft and upload manually on the official website or app.
en.核对成品、来源、封面和文稿，再生成发布资料。B站可辅助填写，小红书由你手动投稿。: Review the video, source, cover and draft, then generate the files. Use assisted filling for Bilibili or post manually on Xiaohongshu.
en.发布资料或素材已变化，请重新核对。: The publication files or media changed. Check them again.
en.文稿已检查，可以生成发布资料。: The drafts are checked. You can generate publication files.
en.已载入发布资料。交接前会再次核对文件。: Publication files loaded. They will be checked again before handoff.
en.这个任务已经在运行，请等待它完成或在原窗口取消。: This task is already running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it in the original window.
en.BS-RoFormer 组件正在安装或使用，请稍后重试。: BS-RoFormer is being installed or used. Try again in a moment.
en.本地音乐与计划摘要不一致，请重新生成准备计划。: The local audio does not match the digest in the preparation plan. Create a new plan and try again.
en.处理完成 · {0} 和伴奏已准备好。: Processing complete · {0} and the instrumental are ready.
en.请等待{0}结束后再检查文件。: Wait for {0} to finish before checking files.
en.请等待{0}结束后再制作混音。: Wait for {0} to finish before creating a mix.
en.来源任务资料不可读；发布文稿、成品和封面已从发布资料包恢复。: The source task cannot be read; the publication drafts, finished video, and cover were restored from the publication bundle.
en.来源任务不可用；发布文稿、成品和封面已从发布资料包恢复，打开平台前会再次校验。: The source task is unavailable; the publication drafts, finished video, and cover were restored from the publication bundle and will be checked again before opening the platform.
en.试听服务已停止；点击播放或 A/B 可重试。: The audition service stopped. Press Play or A/B to retry.
en.默认从开头试听；自动分段最长 30 秒。打开循环可重复当前片段。: Playback starts at the beginning; segments are up to 30 seconds. Enable Loop to repeat the current segment.
en.原混音文件仍在原位置；请确认素材后重新导出。: The previous mix remains in its original location. Check the sources and export again.
en.修改界面语言后，下次启动生效。歌词识别语言在准备页单独选择。: The interface language changes on the next launch. Choose the lyric recognition language separately in Preparation.
en.B站 4:3 与 16:9 封面尚未生成；生成发布资料后可在此查看。: Bilibili 4:3 and 16:9 covers will appear here after publication files are generated.
en.先添加成品与来源资料: Add the finished video and source information
en.先登录或复用已有会话。: Sign in or use an existing session.
en.内容一致并生成发布资料后可用。: Available after matching publication files have been generated.
en.勾选后才会进入本次发布资料。: Include this platform in the publication files.
en.可输入精确百分比；上下按钮按 1% 调整。: Enter an exact percentage; arrow buttons change it by 1%.
en.完成前三步后，在这里核对发布资料。: Complete the first three steps, then review publication files here.
en.尚未选择成品与来源任务: No finished video or source task selected
en.拖动滑条按 1% 调整；右侧可输入精确百分比，0% 表示不应用，旧记录的小数会保: Drag in 1% steps or enter an exact percentage. 0% skips application; saved fractions are retained.
en.拖动滑条按 1% 调整；滚轮用于滚动页面。: Drag in 1% steps; the wheel scrolls the page.
en.按 BV 读取本家资料: Read original credits by BV ID
en.提供本家、STAFF、简介和 B站原封面。: Provides original credits, STAFF, description and the original Bilibili cover.
en.最终发布始终由你在平台网页确认；助手不会提交最终投稿。: Confirm final publication yourself on the platform website.
en.来源任务会提供本家、STAFF 与 B站原封面。: The source task supplies original credits, STAFF and the original Bilibili cover.
en.查看原图或 B站补边封面。: View the original image or padded Bilibili covers.
en.核对成品、来源、封面与平台草稿，最后在平台网页确认发布。: Review the video, sources, cover and drafts, then confirm publication on the platform website.
en.汇总当前选择与资料状态；这里不代表已在平台发布。: Review current selections and file status before publishing.
en.生成发布资料后，B站 4:3 与 16:9 封面会完整补边。: Publication files include fully padded 4:3 and 16:9 Bilibili covers.
en.生成时会固定当前成品；更换视频后请重新生成。: Files capture the current video. Generate them again if you replace it.
en.用于生成标题与署名，之后仍可分别修改两个平台。: Generate titles and credits, then edit each platform separately.
en.登录后会保留浏览器会话，方便再次填写。: Your browser session is retained for later form filling.
en.登录完成后请关闭登录窗口，再打开平台填写；已有会话会继续使用。: Close the sign-in window when done, then open the form. Existing sessions are reused.
en.粘贴本家 BV 号或 B站链接: Paste the original BV ID or Bilibili URL
en.覆盖同名预设？: Replace the preset with this name?
en.设置拟合变化的应用幅度；滑条按 1% 调整。: Set how much of the fitted change to apply, in 1% steps.
en.请填写 1–80 字的名称，不以“内置”开头。: Enter a 1–80 character name that does not start with “内置”.
en.请重新搜索网易云歌词，或在本地填写歌词。: Search NetEase lyrics again or enter lyrics locally.
en.选择封面来源；下方选项会随类型变化。: Choose a cover source to show the available options.
en.选择本次要发布的成品。: Choose the finished video to publish.
en.预览保持原图比例。: The preview retains the original aspect ratio.
en.预设名称（只保存处理参数，不包含歌曲和歌词）: Preset name (processing settings only; no songs or lyrics)
en.拖动滑条按 1% 调整，也可直接输入；0% 不应用。: Drag in 1% steps or enter a percentage; 0% skips application.
en.下载可取消，已下载内容会保留，再次安装会继续。请先结束音乐处理、调音、校准、视频: Downloads can be cancelled and resumed. Finish active processing, tuning, calibration, video, update or cache operations before installing.
en.中文模型已就绪，可离线使用。: The Chinese model is ready for offline use.
en.正在取消下载，已下载部分会保留。: Cancelling; downloaded data will be retained.
en.用于识别中文歌词；日语识别和纯音符提取可继续使用。模型不随精简版预装。: For Chinese lyrics. The lightweight edition omits these weights; Japanese recognition and notes-only extraction remain available.
en.自动尝试备用源，下载后校验文件完整性。: Try alternate sources automatically and verify downloaded files.
en.请等待{0}结束后再安装组件。: Wait for {0} to finish before installing components.
en.中文模型状态无法读取，请运行依赖检查。: Cannot read Chinese model status. Run the dependency check.
en.中文模型已安装 · {0} · 可校验或修复: Chinese model installed · {0} · Verification and repair available
en.中文模型尚未就绪 · 已保留 {0} / {1} · 可从断点继续: Chinese model incomplete · {0} / {1} retained · Ready to resume
en.中文模型未安装 · 下载约 {0} · 可断点续传: Chinese model not installed · Download about {0} · Resumable
en.中文模型缺失（中文歌词识别 · Qwen3-ASR）。请打开“模型与组件”中的“: Chinese lyric recognition requires Qwen3-ASR. Open Models and components → Chinese lyric recognition → Download Chinese model. Downloads can be cancelled and resumed. Japanese and notes-only modes do not require these weights.
en.日语模型缺失（日语歌词识别 · Romaji ASR）。请恢复“日语歌词识别”对: Japanese recognition requires Romaji ASR. Restore its model files; Chinese weights are not used for this feature.
en.所需运行库或模型缺失。: Required runtime or model files are missing.
en.所需运行库缺失。请检查工具路径，并使用 tools/Check-Dependen: Required runtime files are missing. Check the tool paths and run tools/Check-Dependencies.bat.
en.无法连接下载源，请切换下载方式后重试。: Cannot connect to download sources. Select another route and retry.
en.请选择自动、官方源或加速源。: Choose automatic, direct or an acceleration source.
en.指定镜像仅用于对应来源；其他文件直连。优先加速源会按文件来源自动匹配。: A named mirror applies to its matching host; other files use direct downloads. Prefer acceleration selects a matching mirror automatically.
en.在编辑器中调音并导出 Mixdown: Tune in the editor and export a Mixdown
en.合成视频，或直接登记成品: Assemble video or register a finished video
en.在创作中心核对并发布: Review and publish in the creator center
en.选择演唱风格或情绪表达，再调整强度、音高与音色。: Choose a singing style or emotion preset, then adjust strength, pitch and timbre.
en.轻柔起音、稳定的有声核心与渐弱收尾；可分别调整各段表现。: Soft entrances, a stable voiced core, and a tapered release; each phrase segment can be adjusted separately.
en.短促起音、清晰衔接与扎实的持续段；可分别调整各段表现。: Quick entrances, crisp connections, and a solid sustained core; each phrase segment can be adjusted separately.
en.每次只应用一个可见风格；新工程不会在上一次风格结果上继续叠加。: Only one visible style is applied at a time. A new project is not stacked on top of a previous style result.
en.柔和与明亮有力默认联动局部音高与音色，可单独关闭附加音高。: Gentle and Bright & Powerful link local pitch and timbre by default; additional pitch can be disabled separately.
en.各段系数会与风格强度相乘，并同时作用于音色和相应附加音高。: Each segment coefficient is multiplied by the overall style strength and applies to both timbre and the corresponding added pitch.
en.不修改音符、节奏或原有颤音；衔接只调整局部音高连接。关闭附加音高后仅停止音高变化: Notes, timing, and existing vibrato are unchanged. Connection affects only local pitch links. Turning off added pitch stops the pitch changes only.
en.切换风格时保留当前四段系数。: The four segment coefficients are retained when you switch styles.
en.旧风格“{0}”已归并为“{1}”；旧工程保持原样。: The old style “{0}” has been merged into “{1}”; existing projects remain unchanged.
en.尚未添加时间片段。: No time segments have been added yet.
en.先在钢琴卷帘选择时间，再添加当前工具设置。片段不能重叠；执行不会在已有风格结果上: Select a time range on the piano roll, then add the current tool settings. Segments cannot overlap, and execution never stacks onto an existing style result.
en.时间片段只改变所选实际目标轨的风格；参考、校准或沿用参数仍按现有整轨范围处理。: Time segments change style only on the selected target tracks; reference, calibration, or retained parameters still use the existing whole-track scope.
en.已添加 {0} 个时间片段；最多 128 个。: {0} time segment(s) added; up to 128 are allowed.
en.请先在钢琴卷帘选择时间范围，再添加片段。: Select a time range on the piano roll before adding a segment.
en.时间片段最多 128 个。: Up to 128 time segments are allowed.
en.时间片段模式下，“柔和”和“明亮有力”是待添加片段的工具设置；执行只读取片段列表: In time-segment mode, Gentle and Bright & Powerful are tool settings for segments you add; execution reads only the segment list.
en.时间片段列表为空；请添加片段或切回整轨模式。: The time-segment list is empty; add a segment or switch back to Whole track.
en.时间片段模式至少需要一个片段；请添加片段或切回整轨模式。: Time-segment mode requires at least one segment; add one or switch back to Whole track.
en.时间片段需要选择“柔和”或“明亮有力”。: A time segment requires Gentle or Bright & Powerful.
en.风格分段控制必须为对象。: Style segment controls must be an object.
en.拖动选择时间；按 Esc 清除；按住 Ctrl 滚轮缩放。: Drag to select a time range; press Esc to clear; hold Ctrl while scrolling to zoom.
en.拖选时间；上方片段可拖移和拉伸，Delete 删除，Esc 取消。: Drag to select time. Drag a segment above to move or resize it; Delete removes it and Esc cancels.
en.拖选时间；拖动上方片段或边缘可编辑。: Drag to select time; drag a segment above or its edges to edit it.
en.缩放至完整工程: Fit the whole project in view
en.放大当前时间选区: Zoom to the current time selection
en.吸附到附近音符边界；按 Alt 临时关闭: Snap to nearby note boundaries; hold Alt to turn snapping off temporarily.
en.点击片段选中，拖动中部移动，拖动两侧调整范围。: Click a segment to select it; drag its middle to move it or its edges to change its range.
en.时间轴工程数据必须为字典。: Timeline project data must be an object.
en.时间轴选区端点必须是有限数值。: Timeline selection endpoints must be finite numbers.
en.风格时间片段必须为列表。: Style time regions must be a list.
en.较轻的起音、克制的句中力度与下行收尾；保留原有长音起伏。: Lighter entrances, restrained phrase-level intensity and a descending release; existing long-note movement is preserved.
en.轻快的起音与清晰的有声核心，局部音高更利落；不改变音符节奏。: Lighter entrances with a clear voiced core and crisper local pitch movement; note timing is unchanged.
en.含泪感的轻声起收与局部音高上挑；请按所用声库试听。: Tearful, quiet onsets and releases with local upward pitch movement; audition with the selected voicebank.
en.情绪预设默认联动局部音高与音色，可单独关闭附加音高。: Emotion presets enable local pitch and timbre together by default. The added pitch can be switched off separately.
en.在原工程上添加所选风格的局部增量，生成后请在声库中试听。: Add local increments for the selected style to the original project, then audition the result in the voicebank.
en.输入文件已发生变化，请重新分析音频对齐后再合成。: The input files changed. Analyze audio alignment again before assembly.
en.尚未分析音频对齐。: Audio alignment has not been analyzed yet.
en.原视频或 Mixdown 已变化，请重新分析音频对齐。: The source video or Mixdown changed. Analyze audio alignment again.
en.自动对齐结果不够可靠；请试听 Mixdown 后手动填写偏移。: Automatic alignment was not reliable enough. Audition the Mixdown, then enter a manual offset.
en.先分析原视频音轨与 Mixdown，获取建议偏移和可信状态。: Analyze the source video's audio track and the Mixdown to obtain a suggested offset and reliability status.
en.自动对齐：已校验生成前分析，合成时会复用建议偏移。: Automatic alignment: the suggested offset from the verified pre-render analysis will be reused during assembly.
en.请等待音频对齐分析结束或先取消分析。: Wait for audio-alignment analysis to finish, or cancel it first.
en.请选择可用的原视频和 Mixdown 后再分析音频对齐。: Select a valid source video and Mixdown before analyzing audio alignment.
en.无法读取输入文件信息，请重新选择后再分析。: The input file details could not be read. Select the files again before analyzing.
en.当前分析结果已失效，请重新分析音频对齐。: The current analysis is stale. Analyze audio alignment again.
en.正在停止音频对齐分析；结束后可再次开始合成。: Stopping audio-alignment analysis. You can start assembly again when it finishes.
en.请等待首帧预览结束或先取消预览。: Wait for the first-frame preview to finish, or cancel the preview first.
en.当前版本不支持生成前音频对齐分析。: This version does not support pre-render audio-alignment analysis.
en.已使用建议偏移 {:+.3f} 秒，并切换为手动偏移。: Used suggested offset {:+.3f} s and switched to a manual offset.
en.已使用建议偏移 {:+.3f} 秒；合成时将按手动偏移处理。: Using suggested offset {:+.3f} s; assembly will treat it as a manual offset.
en.自动对齐：尚未采用不可靠的分析结果；请试听后手动偏移。: Automatic alignment: the unreliable result was not applied. Audition it and use a manual offset.
en.分析结果缺少有效的建议偏移，请重试。: The analysis result has no valid suggested offset. Try again.
en.分析结果缺少输入校验信息，请重新分析。: The analysis result is missing input verification data. Analyze again.
en.未能可靠判断音频偏移，未自动采用。请试听 Mixdown 后手动填写偏移。: The audio offset could not be determined reliably and was not applied automatically. Audition the Mixdown, then enter a manual offset.
en.建议偏移：{:+.3f} 秒。请试听确认后选择“使用建议偏移”。: Suggested offset: {:+.3f} s. Audition it, then choose “Use suggested offset”.
en.建议偏移：{:+.3f} 秒，但结果不够可靠，未自动采用。请试听 Mixdown: Suggested offset: {:+.3f} s, but the result was not reliable enough and was not applied automatically. Audition the Mixdown, then enter a manual offset.
en.无法可靠确认自动对齐偏移。: The automatic-alignment offset could not be established reliably.
en.对齐结果通过质量与唯一性检查。: The alignment result passed the quality and uniqueness checks.
en.参考音频或 Mixdown 少于 5 秒，无法可靠自动对齐。: The reference audio or Mixdown is shorter than 5 seconds; automatic alignment cannot be reliable.
en.参考音频没有明显能量变化，无法可靠自动对齐。: The reference audio has no clear energy variation, so automatic alignment cannot be reliable.
en.Mixdown 没有明显能量变化，无法可靠自动对齐。: The Mixdown has no clear energy variation, so automatic alignment cannot be reliable.
en.搜索范围内没有达到最低重叠比例的候选。: No candidate within the search range reached the minimum overlap ratio.
en.最佳候选位于搜索边界，无法确认真实偏移。: The best candidate lies at the search boundary, so the true offset cannot be confirmed.
en.最佳候选相关度不足，无法可靠确认偏移。: The best candidate has insufficient correlation, so the offset cannot be confirmed reliably.
en.存在相近的多个峰值，无法唯一确认偏移。: Multiple similar peaks exist, so the offset cannot be identified uniquely.
en.自动对齐：未获得对齐结果。: Automatic alignment: no alignment result was obtained.
en.保留输入工程现有参数，不添加所选风格。: Keep the input project's current expression and add no selected style.
en.柔和、悲伤与明亮欢快默认联动局部音高与音色，可单独关闭附加音高。: Gentle, Sad, and Bright & Cheerful link local pitch and timbre by default; added pitch can be disabled separately.
en.时间片段模式下，“柔和”“悲伤”和“明亮欢快”是待添加片段的工具设置；执行只读取: In time-segment mode, Gentle, Sad, and Bright & Cheerful are tool settings for segments you add; execution reads only the segment list.
en.时间片段需要选择“柔和”“悲伤”或“明亮欢快”。: A time segment requires Gentle, Sad, or Bright & Cheerful.
en.轻快起音、清晰衔接与明亮的持续段；可分别调整各段表现。: Light, quick entrances, crisp connections, and a bright sustained core; each phrase segment can be adjusted separately.
en.柔和侧重声线；悲伤侧重句中收敛和下行收尾；明亮欢快侧重清晰、利落的起音。: Gentle focuses on vocal texture; Sad focuses on mid-phrase restraint and a descending release; Bright & Cheerful focuses on clear, crisp entrances.
en.保持清楚的有声核心，长音中段收敛，句尾缓慢下落；与柔和声线分开控制。: Maintain a clear voiced core, restrain the middle of long notes, and let phrase endings fall slowly; this is controlled separately from the Gentle vocal texture.
en.点击上方片段选中；拖动移动，拖动边缘调整范围。: Click a segment above to select it; drag it to move, or drag its edges to resize.
en.片段开始时间（秒，可输入 3 位小数）。: Segment start time in seconds (three decimal places allowed).

en.预设会追加到当前预设库；不会覆盖素材、任务或旧导出。: The preset will be added to the current preset library; it will not overwrite assets, tasks, or previous exports.
en.默认附加到本机库，保留已有预设；导入不会应用到当前工程。: Added to the local library by default; existing presets are kept. Importing does not apply it to the current project.
en.；比例不同时补黑边，完整保留原图。: ; letterbox when aspect ratios differ and preserve the full image.
en.dB；双击恢复 0 dB: dB; double-click to reset to 0 dB
en.数值已按当前采样率与控件精度调整。: Values adjusted to the current sample rate and control precision.

en.四种来源共用当前轨道与区间；外部声库渲染仍由你手动完成。: All four sources use the current track and range. Render the external voicebank manually.
en.在 Synthesizer V 打开七轨试音工程。用同一声库从零秒分轨导出，保留: Open the seven-track test project in Synthesizer V. Export separate tracks from zero seconds with the same voicebank, keep track names and turn off mixed export. Fitting uses only the selected vocal track.

en.旧结果已过期: Previous result is out of date

en.精确增益、声像和时间偏移: Precise gain, pan and timing offset

en.输入歌词查找；重复词会以轨道和时间区分。: Enter lyrics to search. Repeated lyrics are identified by track and time.

en.同轨后添加、移动、调整或更新的整组风格会覆盖旧片段；其他轨道不受影响。: Adding, moving, resizing or updating a segment replaces the overlapping style settings on this track only.
en.拖选松手后应用当前风格和唱腔并保存草稿；点音符或输入时间仍只选择。同轨重叠时以新: Release the drag to apply the style and technique and save the draft. Clicking a note or entering time only selects it. The newest segment wins on overlap; the outer parts remain.
en.已添加逐轨片段；同轨重叠部分以新风格为准。: Added track segments. The new style takes priority where they overlap.
en.已更新片段；同轨重叠部分以当前整组风格为准。: Segment updated. Its style settings take priority where they overlap.
en.已将片段移动到完整音符范围；重叠部分以此片段为准。: Moved the segment to full note boundaries. It takes priority where it overlaps.
en.重叠覆盖后留下的旧片段无法对齐到完整歌词音符。: The remaining part cannot be aligned to complete lyric notes.
en.风格时间片段 ID 必须唯一。: Style segment IDs must be unique.
en.已添加 {count} 个逐轨片段；同轨重叠部分已按新风格整理。: Added {count} track segments. The newest style takes priority where segments overlap.
en.选择任务，查看产物并继续制作。: Choose a task, inspect its files, and continue.
en.从左侧选择一个任务。: Select a task on the left.
en.历史版本只读，不参与当前交付或下一步。: Previous versions are read-only and excluded from handoff.
en.暂无可交接的产物: No output ready to hand off
en.当前交付见中间栏。: See the center pane for the current output.
en.当前交付已变化，请核对后再继续。: The current output changed. Review it before continuing.
en.此任务还没有人工登记。自动生成并核验通过的产物仍会显示在产物列表。: No manual bindings. Verified automatic outputs still appear in the list.
en.选择产物查看状态、来源和本地操作。: Select an output to see its status, source, and actions.
en.选择任务后显示当前交付与下一步。: Select a task to see its output and next step.
en.重命名只修改任务名称；删除会移除整个任务目录，并继续受现有引用与忙状态保护。: Renaming changes the label only. Deleting removes the task folder; active references still prevent deletion.
en.打开 SVP 工程后，可在单轨卷帘逐句精修，或切到多轨泳道比较重复歌词。: Open an SVP project to refine lyrics on one track or compare matching lyrics across tracks.
en.拖选松手后应用当前风格和唱腔并保存草稿；点音符或输入时间仍只选择。同轨后添加、移: Release a drag to apply the current style and technique and save the draft. Clicking notes or entering times only selects. The latest edit replaces overlaps on the same track.

en.勾选批量目标后显示逐轨泳道: Select batch targets to show track lanes
en.另有 {count} 轨，从焦点框选择: {count} more tracks in the focus selector
en.多轨泳道与焦点钢琴卷帘: Track lanes and focused piano roll
en.当前时间没有歌词: No lyrics in this time range
en.当前时间没有音符，可搜索歌词或平移: No notes in view. Search lyrics or pan.
en.点击音符选段，拖拽选择时间。左右键找音符，回车选择；上下键或键轨滚轮移动音高。滚: Click a note or drag a range. Left and right find notes; Enter selects. Use Up and Down or scroll the keyboard to move vertically. Scroll to zoom, or Shift-scroll to pan.
en.焦点轨在当前时间没有音符；点击泳道切换焦点，或勾选批量目标: No notes in the focused track here. Choose a lane or batch targets.
en.首次生成时创建会话: Session is created on first generation

ja.打开 SVP 工程后，可在单轨卷帘逐句精修，或切到多轨泳道比较重复歌词。: SVP を開くと、単一トラックで歌詞を調整したり、複数トラックで一致箇所を比較したりできます。
